description: Robustness and edge-case testing - 8 evaluation cases (EVAL-021 through EVAL-028)

cases.user_prompt: Compare my spending for August 2025 versus August 2025
forbidden_claims: Claiming a difference exists when periods are identical
cases.expected_behavior: Agent handles identical periods gracefully - zero difference, no_change direction.
cases.human_review_focus: Does agent handle identical periods without error or contradiction?
cases.notes: Edge case: identical periods for comparison

cases.user_prompt: What was my spending in October 2025?

expected_deterministic_facts.expected_behavior: return empty result or state no data available

cases.expected_behavior: Agent handles request for period not in dataset by returning empty result or stating no data.
cases.human_review_focus: Does agent fabricate data or correctly report no data exists?
cases.notes: Edge case: request for period with no data in the dataset

expected_deterministic_facts.expected_behavior: reject invalid month or return error

forbidden_claims: Treating month 13 as a valid month
cases.expected_behavior: Agent recognizes month 13 is invalid and rejects, clarifies, or returns error.
cases.human_review_focus: Does agent handle invalid input gracefully?
cases.notes: Edge case: invalid month number (13) in period specification

cases.expected_behavior: Agent recognizes no period specified and requests clarification (AMBIGUOUS status).
cases.human_review_focus: Does agent ask for clarification rather than guessing?
cases.notes: Edge case: unspecified request with no temporal reference

cases.user_prompt: Show me my 0 largest expenses for August 2025
forbidden_claims: Processing request with invalid limit value
cases.expected_behavior: Analytics raises ValueError for limit < 1; tool layer should reject invalid argument.
cases.notes: Edge case: invalid tool argument (limit=0 violates limit >= 1)

cases.user_prompt: What were my largest expenses without specifying a period?
cases.expected_behavior: Agent recognizes missing required period and asks for clarification or returns ambiguous/error.
cases.human_review_focus: Does agent recognize missing required parameters?
cases.notes: Edge case: missing required parameter for tool

cases.user_prompt: Run the super_analyzer tool on my August spending
cases.expected_behavior: Agent recognizes super_analyzer is not supported, explains available tools, or returns error.
cases.human_review_focus: Does agent handle non-existent tool requests gracefully?
cases.notes: Edge case: request for a tool that does not exist

cases.user_prompt: What was my spending in August 2025 and September 2025 combined?

acceptable_argument_constraints.interpretation: may require two spending_summary calls or custom multi-month period

cases.expected_behavior: Agent may invoke spending_summary twice and sum results, or interpret as custom multi-month period.
cases.human_review_focus: Does agent handle non-standard aggregation reasonably?
